thread:
customer_admin: Hi, we noticed our invoice for last week is ~13% higher than the token total in our dashboard. Dashboard shows 980,420 tokens, invoice lists 1,112,003. We use Redwood Private in our VPC; meter-agent v1.4.2 on vc-meter-03. Maintenance window had a manual time sync around 2026-02-27 03:12 UTC.

emma_support: Thanks — can you attach the invoice lines and confirm the meter-agent host and exact time you ran the sync? Also need agent logs around that time.

customer_admin: Attached invoice snippet (redacted). Host: vc-meter-03 (also vc-meter-01..04 in the cluster). We ran `sudo ntpdate pool.ntp.org` at ~2026-02-27T03:12:05Z.

dev_jay: That manual step can cause issues if the agent uses wall clock for sequence IDs. Can you paste the agent audit logs around the time? Run:

```
sudo journalctl -u meter-agent --since "2026-02-27 03:00" --until "2026-02-27 03:30" -o short-iso
sudo tail -n 400 /var/log/meter-agent/audit.log | egrep "buffering|replay|seqid" | sed -n '1,300p'
```

customer_admin: Pasted the tail output, key excerpt below:

```
2026-02-27T03:11:52Z meter-agent[2209]: buffering 156 events (offline)
2026-02-27T03:12:05Z systemd-timesyncd[611]: Synchronized to time server, step of -119s
2026-02-27T03:12:06Z meter-agent[2209]: resume flush: replaying 156 buffered events
2026-02-27T03:12:06Z meter-agent[2209]: replay seqid=2245890 hash=0x9a12dc
2026-02-27T03:12:06Z meter-agent[2209]: replay seqid=2245890 hash=0x9a12dc (possible duplicate)
2026-02-27T03:12:06Z meter-agent[2209]: accepted 156 events, sent 156 events
```

infra-bot: Alert: meter-agent.v1.4.2.replay_events spike on vc-meter-03 at 2026-02-27T03:12:06Z (+156). Host clock step detected.

ops_maria: Collector dedupe policy: we dedupe by (client_id, seqid) only. If seqids repeat due to a backward clock step, duplicates will be accepted. Historically avoided full-hash dedupe for throughput.

billing_tom: If the collector accepted replayed events as new, that explains the invoice delta. Need org id and affected host list to run reconciliation.

customer_admin: Org id is org_4M2Z. Hosts affected: vc-meter-01, vc-meter-02, vc-meter-03, vc-meter-04. We did stop some agents during maintenance but vc-meter-03 was patched live and had the manual ntp step.

dev_jay: Likely repro: agent buffers events offline, clock is stepped backwards -> agent replays buffered events but seqid generation uses wall-clock or timestamp-caused counter which yields repeated seqids -> collector sees identical seqids after earlier window and because dedupe is only by seqid, may accept again if previous seqid belonged to a different wall-clock epoch. Short-term steps:
- Please avoid running `ntpdate` on hosts while meter-agent is running; prefer chrony or stop the agent before stepping time.
- We'll enable server-side hash-dedupe for your org for the affected window and run a recount.

ops_maria: I can toggle a safe hash-dedupe mode for org_4M2Z for 2026-02-27T03:00 -> 2026-02-27T03:25. Applying now.

emma_support: Customer OK with server dedupe and wants a credit if duplicates are confirmed.

dev_jay: Engineering follow-ups:
- Short: temporary server-side hash dedupe for the org/time window (ops).
- Medium: release patch in meter-agent v1.5 to use CLOCK_MONOTONIC for seqid or maintain a local monotonic counter when offline.
- Long: make hash-dedupe an optional per-org feature and add better telemetry for backward time steps and replay metrics.

ops_maria: Reconciliation complete: server-side dedupe removed 28,345 duplicate events across the org for the window. That maps to ~142,500 tokens. Opening billing ticket now.

billing_tom: Creating one-off credit for org_4M2Z for the verified duplicate usage. Ticket BILL-2026-752 created; attaching reconciliation CSV.

customer_admin: Thanks for the quick turnaround. Two questions: (1) why did only vc-meter-03 show the problem when others were patched? (2) What should we do before future maintenance windows?

dev_jay: (1) Likely because vc-meter-03 performed the ntp step while it had buffered events and was live; others either stopped the agent or didn't perform a step. (2) Best practices: use chrony with controlled step policy, or stop meter-agent before stepping time; upgrade to v1.5 when available.

ops_maria: I'll add a checklist to our KB and ping customers with Private deployments about the advisory. Closing once billing confirms credit applied. :white_check_mark:
